scope: Historical public-460 same-question summaries, not current 0.1.0 inference acceptance or a paired route/machine/time benchmark.

conditions.luna: Archived first public-460 Luna summary, ordinary Codex OAuth Responses. Runner config sets four concurrent client workers; actual concurrency, run start, build and per-request traces unavailable.
conditions.jev: Published historical TypeSafe cloud results. Risk requested alias jev-latest, not an immutable served checkpoint; toxicity/tool_select returned jev-1.13.0. Separate clients, machines, dates and inference routes.
conditions.latency: Observed end-to-end request wall time, including network. No paired speed ratio, SLA, inference-only time or 0.1.0 measurement.
conditions.accuracy: Original gold and case IDs; all planned requests in each denominator. Tool selection scores function choice, not generated arguments.
conditions.probability: Brier uses complete vectors: binary squared error versus multiclass sum, never pooled. Max-p ECE differs from public Choice confidence. No calibration certification.
conditions.provenance_gap: Original run.json and per-request traces are unavailable in the retained evidence. Only derived summary, frozen input/source manifests and runner/scorer are available. These are not freshly reconstructed raw inference results.

typesafe_jev.terms: Vendor-published early-access price; cache/tier/region/contract terms not independently established.

ordinary_luna_api_reference.tier: Standard, short context; no cache read/write events or other surcharges

product_subscription.meaning: Existing eligible native Codex subscription access and limits; no separate metered Platform/TypeSafe API charge for this route. Not free or unlimited; API rate cards do not estimate included tasks.

pricing.assumptions: rate_in*input/1e6 + rate_out*output/1e6. Fixed same-token envelopes, not equal-wire workloads or observed vendor usage/bills. All reference input assumed uncached, with no billed cache writes; short context, Standard tier, no regional premium, tax, retries or extras. Native Jev token usage/cache split for this cohort is not established; subscription cost cannot be inferred from these token counts.

paid_credit_illustration.basis: Optional after-included-limit credit-billed Standard example; not included quota percent, purchase advice or activated fallback

local_interval_method.unit: used percentage points within the same quota window
requires: same account/plan/workspace/window with unchanged reset identifier
same model/reasoning/speed tier/call path/request mix and generation/retry policy
settled meter, no shared/other account activity
local_interval_method.forecast_scope: Local stable-workload linear forecast before reset, meter saturation or model switch; not guaranteed capacity. Five-hour and weekly estimated separately; take tighter. No invented shared deduction ratio.
local_interval_method.rounding_assumption: Nearest whole-percent rounding assumed for the illustration; actual UI/server display rounding rule unverified

community_sources.evidence_level: Unverified original user report; method only
limits: author excluded resets/idle/overlapping main sessions; complete account isolation not independently checked
not a pinned Luna decision workload; no coefficient transferred

community_sources.plan: Pro as identified by account-limit response, multiplier unknown
limits: other machines/remote/background activity may be omitted
reasoning/client version not fixed in this selected comparison
not a verified entitlement reduction or Luna quota conversion

community_sources.evidence_level: Low-confidence original Luna user claim, excluded from numerical estimates
limits: full raw token/cache/reasoning data unavailable in fetched post
API-dollar normalization is not included quota metering
uninterrupted windows and Pro multipliers not established

decision_bench_v4.scope: Three series scored on the same 1,071 rows with the benchmark's own scoring code, unchanged. Jev 1.13 and Luna through the Decisions API are the benchmark's published runs; Luna through this project was run locally on 2026-10-13. Not paired in time, route or machine, and not the public-460 suites.
decision_bench_v4.brier_definition: Per row, sum over all classes of (p_class - 1[class is gold])^2, averaged over rows with a valid answer and probabilities (decision_bench/scoring.py at the harness commit). For binary tasks this is twice a single squared error, so it is not comparable with the Brier values of the public-460 suites.

caveats.jev_images: Jev 1.13 has no vision input: it scored the 122 image rows (DAT-3, DOC-1, DSN-1, FIN-3) from text renderings. Both Luna series were sent the images.
caveats.api_latency_route: Luna through the Decisions API was timed by the benchmark authors through OpenRouter on their machines, Jev by its own harness; ours is local wall time on one machine through the Codex app-server and the ChatGPT backend.
caveats.ours_errors: One row (PRD-1) ended in an invalid_output error after 3 attempts and counts as wrong in every metric.
caveats.not_paired: Series differ in run date (2026-09-23, 2026-10-08, 2026-10-13), harness commit and machine.
